scope: One raw diagnostic with the executor five 8192-bit FIFO directions and actual nonblocking reads/writes, complete 1024-byte collect/repack, two consumed input pairs and three independent output lanes. Host uses an explicitly test-only bounded depth2 stream peer because installed host hls::stream is unbounded; HLS uses installed Vitis hls::stream without that define. Full byte oracle and source backpressure coverage do not prove generated RTL backpressure.
